name: Hazel medium – 4 seasons × 4 views
description: Owner's Blender model shrubs-hazel-2 (15 Nov 2026): four seasons in the four isometric views of the trees. On the map a shrub can use any of the four views for variety, as the trees do.

variants.name: Hazel medium, spring 0° (front-right)
variants.notes: Owner's Blender render (15 Nov 2026, Keře a houštiny): spring, view 0° (front-right), same camera as the trees; all seasons of this view share the crop and anchor. 1x game scale (tile 64 px wide).
